appIcon:
Use case: identity-preserve. Input 1 is the canonical identity reference; input 2 is the current game's illustration style and green/ivory kit reference. Create a finished premium iPhone game app icon for IGNACIO MUSTACHO, a fictional shadow-basketball rhythm game. Exactly square 1024 x 1024 pixels, full-bleed opaque RGB artwork, NO alpha, NO rounded corners (iOS will mask corners), no border outside image.
Close-up portrait with his whole iconic hairstyle and enormous moustache safely inside a 12% margin: brown skin, giant expressive brown eyes, very thick eyebrows, dense black full fringe, wide smoothly swept-up side hair wings (not curls), gigantic wide curled moustache. Same adult face as canonical reference, slightly raised eyebrow and subtle confident mischievous smile, memorable and sophisticated rather than baby-like. Upper edge of dark forest-green basketball jersey with warm ivory piping visible at bottom, no numbers needed.
High-end sculpted 3D editorial sports illustration matching game, clean large shapes readable at 40 pixels, rich carefully modeled face, warm arena spotlight from upper left, crisp silhouette. Deep forest-green background with a restrained warm ivory circular arena-light halo behind the head and a small burnt-orange glow near lower edge. Keep background simple and matte, no arena clutter. Face fills center and moustache spans most of width. Dark hair must clearly separate from background with warm rim light.
No letters, words, initials, watermark, NBA/team brands, ball, hoop, sparkles or excessive gloss. Produce one polished icon, not a mockup, not multiple sizes.
